title: Inequality and poverty: growth without equality
goal: Read why growth in the 1990s did not reduce inequality, using aunque with facts.

items: I can say what many countries achieved in the 1990s and what did not improve.
I can explain what inequality is and what the Gini coefficient measures.
I can say why growth did not create enough formal jobs.
I can contrast a gain and a problem with *aunque* + indicative.
